description:
Where and when a pulse and legume gene is expressed, and under which treatments it changes, from Expression Atlas, the Legume Information System for chickpea and pea, and faba bean studies quantified by askPulse.
gene: Ensembl gene ID (e.g. GLYMA_01G000600, pea Psat1g000360), a chickpea CDC Frontier v3 ID (Ca1g000100) or a gene name find_gene resolves. Baseline: TPM (median over replicates,
with range) for the top_groups highest-expressed tissues/stages per experiment. Differential: every contrast where
the gene is significant (adjusted p < 0.05, |log2FC| >= 1). experiment restricts to one accession; otherwise the
max_experiments baseline experiments with the highest TPM are detailed and the rest listed with their maximum.
name: gene_expression
